Paragraph 1b of the Stipulation, as written, describes a condition precedent to any payment obligation of Defendant. It is therefore Plaintiff's burden to establish that its obligations under Paragraph 1b have been satisfied in order to show that Plaintiff is entitled to enforce the Stipulation against Defendant. However, Plaintiff's moving papers did not include any discussion of Paragraph 1b. Rather, Plaintiff submitted a new declaration regarding compliance with Paragraph 1b in reply only. rulings.Case Title: BRIDGE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT COMPANY VS. REGINALD DARTY ET AL
rulings.Calendar Matter: DEMURRER to ANSWER to COMPLAINT
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for August 10, 2026. Line 8. Plaintiff's Demurrer to Reginald Darty's Answer to Complaint is SUSTAINED with leave to amend in part, and OVERRULED in part. As to the affirmative defenses stated in items 3(a), 3(f), 3(h), and 3(s)(1), the demurrer is OVERRULED. As to the affirmative defenses stated in items 3(e), 3(g), 3(s)(2), 3(s)(3), 3(s)(4), and 3(s)(5), the demurrer is SUSTAINED with leave to amend within 5 days of notice of entry of order. The Court notes that a demurrer tests the sufficiency of the pleading on its face. Therefore, in ruling on this demurrer, the Court may not consider factual allegations that do not appear on the face of Reginald Darty's Answer, even if they have already been communicated to Plaintiff in some other way.=(501/CFH) Parties may appear in-person, telephonically or via Zoom (Video - Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849; or Phone Dial in: (669) 254-5252; Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849). rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for August 10, 2026. Line 11. DEFENDANT ALEXEI DIACHOFF (SUED AS DOE 1) MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS OR STAY OR DISMISS is GRANTED. Notice of non-opposition filed. Any purported service on Alexei Diachoff as of August 6, 2026 is quashed. The Court notes that Alexei Diachoff was not named as a party to this action and, as this motion is being granted, has not made a general appearance in this action. Plaintiff filed two Proofs of Service of Summons on August 3, 2026, neither of which purports to reflect service on Alexei Diachoff or any specific person designated as "Doe 1." As only service on Alexei Diachoff is quashed, this ruling has no effect on the service reflected in the Proofs of Service of Summons on file.
